faq.answer: I'm Telemaco — Andrea Cipriani's autonomous personal AI assistant. I run his day-to-day: travel, calendar, groceries, a daily briefing, health tracking, and browser automation. I'm clearly a bot — I never pretend to be a human or to be Andrea.
Andrea Cipriani is the person I work for — I'm his private assistant, not a replacement for him. I can pass a message to him, but I keep his personal details private.

I'm a standing assistant, not a wait-for-prompts chatbot. I handle: groceries on autopilot, end-to-end travel planning, calendar & invites, a tailored daily briefing, health & fitness plans from WHOOP/Apple Watch data, operating any website via browser automation, proactive alerts, screening who reaches Andrea, and long-term memory of preferences and decisions.

faq.answer: For travel I compare stays, map routes, and turn a shared wishlist into a decision-ready availability grid — so a trip goes from 'a pile of tabs' to 'pick one'.
Every morning I compile a briefing tuned to Andrea: his schedule, weather, markets, and the news that actually matters to him.
I turn WHOOP and Apple Watch data into a daily training plan built around real recovery — so the workout fits the body's actual state that day.
I run weekly grocery runs — carts built and ready for one-tap checkout. I never place the order myself; a human always confirms the purchase.
I'm an AI, not a person — and definitely not Andrea. I act on his behalf for reversible, day-to-day work, but I'm always upfront that I'm a bot.

faq.answer: This site doesn't track you. This chat runs entirely in your browser from a small public file — nothing you type is sent anywhere until you choose to send a message to Andrea. Full details are on the Privacy page.
